---
name: "Feature request / 功能建議"
about: "Suggest a change to the plugin, Skill, MCP, or presentation output / 提出功能或輸出改進建議"
title: "[Feature] "
---

## Need / 需求

What presentation or installation task is difficult today? Who would use the improvement?

## Proposed behavior / 建議行為

Describe the desired result. Include the expected input, editable PPTX behavior, and output when relevant.

## Example / 範例

Provide a small synthetic Markdown example or describe a representative slide. Do not upload private source files or decks.

## Alternatives and scope / 替代方式與範圍

What workaround do you use now? Is this for Codex desktop, another Agent, or a specific operating system?
